cases.question: What is break-even ACOS?
cases.answer:
Break-even ACOS is the ACOS at which a sale pays for its own advertising and nothing more, equaling the profit margin before ad cost.
Running above break-even ACOS loses money on the ad-attributed sale, though the sale may still be worth it for launch or ranking reasons.
A target ACOS is usually set below break-even ACOS to leave room for profit.
